body.notes: Full clone at main d801cea, sigstore 4.5.1 + opentimestamps-client 0.8.0 in a venv, 2026-11-06: verify, check-anchors and monitor all exit 0 (monitor: 6 refs, 3 Rekor entries, none unexplained). Attacks: hand-written entry -> exit 1 (never attested); fully re-referenced history rewrite -> exit 1 (OTS bytes, sigstore subject, coverage); orphan laundering with the real statement and hidden entries -> exit 1 (published and later removed); corrupted signature with dead network -> exit 1. Anchor verified with the sigstore CLI and the sha256 chain recomputed in Node.js (JCS). One weakness, not a false 0: a deleted .ots anchor for a range head is not reported (the Rekor attestation still pins the bytes, so no lie is possible); suggested fix in the report. Report and artifacts: exagium-z-verify-20261106 (report.md).
